data: A day hike up Rax from Vienna. Started at the Preinerwiese trailhead, up to Ottohaus, then the ridge walk to Heukuppe (2007 m) and back down the same way.

Route

Preinerwiese → Ottohaus → Heukuppe → Ottohaus → Preinerwiese. Well-marked, some exposed sections near the summit ridge.

Conditions

Clear, warm, light wind on the ridge. Started early to avoid the afternoon crowds on the plateau.

Gear notes

Trail shoes were fine for this route; no scrambling gear needed for this line.
